The '''Coalition''' was a group of businesses and corporations that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

==History==
Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Coalition staged a takeover of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and planned to take control of all commerce in the Cularin system. The Coalition organized their takeover from within a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that they had purchased from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and the [[Cularin Militia]] staged an [[Battle of Tolea Biqua|attack]] on the craft while it was near to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on Genarius. The Militia succeeded in destroying the craft, causing wreckage from it to rain down onto Tolea Biqua, making the atmosphere of Genarius more unstable and rendering the planet uninhabitable.<ref name="Price of Neutrality">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060119Rebellion|text=The Price of Neutrality -- Rebellion|int=The Price of Neutrality -- Rebellion}}</ref>
